definitions.explanation: an administrative unit within a Japanese university's graduate school, roughly equivalent to a graduate department or faculty in Western universities

examples.japanese: ⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧{研究科|けんきゅうか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進学|しんがく}→進学：03256_shingaku⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I entered the Graduate School of Engineering.

examples.japanese: {研究科|けんきゅうか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{入試|にゅうし}→入試：04705_nyuushi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The graduate school entrance exams will be held next month.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{人文科学|じんぶんかがく}{研究科|けんきゅうか}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{自然科学|しぜんかがく}→自然科学：24834_shizenkagaku⟧{研究科|けんきゅうか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、{博士課程|はくしかてい}⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: This university has graduate divisions for humanities and natural sciences, with doctoral programs established in both.

notes:
In the Japanese university system, {研究科|けんきゅうか} is the graduate-level counterpart of {学部|がくぶ} (undergraduate faculty/department). It is the organizational unit under the ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧ (graduate school). Official names typically follow the pattern "X{研究科|けんきゅうか}" where X is the field of study.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧{研究科|けんきゅうか}: graduate school division
- ⟦{法学|ほうがく}→法学：28413_hougaku⟧{研究科|けんきゅうか}: Graduate School of Law
- ⟦{医学|いがく}→医学：01301_igaku⟧{研究科|けんきゅうか}: Graduate School of Medicine
- {研究科|けんきゅうか}{長|ちょう}: dean of a graduate division

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学部|がくぶ}: undergraduate faculty — the undergraduate-level equivalent
- ⟦{大学院|だいがくいん}→大学院：04783_daigakuin⟧: graduate school — the broader institution containing multiple {研究科|けんきゅうか}
- ⟦{学科|がっか}→学科：00053_gakka⟧: department; course of study — a smaller division within a {学部|がくぶ} or {研究科|けんきゅうか}
